Delhi's 'Sheesh Mahal' Residence to Open for Public Tours

Delhi's 'Sheesh Mahal', the residence of former Chief Minister Arvind Kejriwal, is set to be opened for public tours. The announcement was made by Delhi Minister Parvesh Singh. The PWD Minister also confirmed the decision to allow public access to the residence.
